| description = A nasty wizard that is in a room with 2 other mobs and one pathing mob; break carefully and keep out of his line of sight as he casts unless you feel like eating an ice comet for breakfast. Dispel before fight because he MR buffs himself but even debuffed he remains quite magic resistant. Even Tashed he'll resist a good number of root/stuns but can be slowed. Runs at low health. Able to be Raptured.

He will cast some dangerous spells like [[Rend]], [[Ice Comet]], and [[Enticement of Flame]], as well as snares, roots, stuns, and dispels. Make sure your tank has enough HP to live through an Ice Comet.

The trash mobs on his left and right respawn every 20 minutes, not the zone normal 22 minutes. On top of the pather in his room there is also another pather that roams from the main lava room to nearly into the efreeti cubby, keep him in mind and watch out when pulling him as he can bring the mobs outside guarding that corridor.
